summary: Computes a scroll-bar thumb pixel position on `this`. Reads the item count from MenuCursorCount_bc90(this), subtracts 1, and if that count exceeds 0 writes `(this+0xEC * this+0x114 + count/2) / count` to this+0x110; otherwise writes 0. Then clamps this+0x110 into [0, this+0x114] and returns the (pre-clamp) value read back. Integer rounding via the +count/2 term. Caller BoundedCounterUpdate (0047BAE0) drives it for menu cursor scrolling.

local_names.count: MenuCursorCount_bc90(this) - 1, used as divisor and rounding term
local_names.track: this+0x114, scroll track size used as clamp ceiling

operations.description: v2 = MenuCursorCount_bc90(this) - 1; obtain total item count from the menu cursor counter.
If v2 > 0, compute proportional position; else write 0 to this+0x110.
this+0x110 = (this+0xEC * this+0x114 + v2/2) / v2; map scroll offset to a pixel position with integer rounding.
else branch: this+0x110 = 0 when the count is not positive.
result = this+0x110; v4 = this+0x114; reload the computed position and the track size.
Clamp: if result < 0 write 0; else if result > v4 write v4 to this+0x110.
Return the pre-clamp position value held in result.

unresolved: Semantics of this+0xEC (scroll offset) and this+0x114 (track) as menu UI metrics is DERIVED from the field reads and the MenuCursorCount_bc90 divisor; the owning menu widget type is unidentified.
The pre-clamp value (not the clamped one) is returned; callers may consume a value that exceeds the clamp bounds.
